svg.font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: A simulated fleet and the real van drive the same streets and share one event store — with different permissions.
one row per stop: time + address
Both fleets read and write the same event store — the difference is what each is allowed to change.
Simulated vans only tidy up their own objects; the real van is the source of truth.
the map shows it until then.
downtown Berkeley — what the user sees
reads the block, deletes simulated only
